ontology.A_scenario: Unchanged exogenous D0/D1/D2 competence paths, C5 all-tasks demand, 3 agents x 3 tasks, 300 periods, existing 20 paired evaluation seeds.
ontology.B_mechanism: True competence generates Bernoulli rewards; observed competence is clipped true competence plus independent seeded Gaussian noise. LinUCB updates only from assigned-pair rewards; no agent learning is introduced.
ontology.C_organization: Trained fixed map; existing P0 applied to matching candidates using observed competence; existing LinUCB+matching using observed competence; true-competence oracle is evaluator-only.
ontology.policy_learning_vs_agent_learning: Only LinUCB policy parameters learn; competence trajectories remain exogenous and policy-independent.

configuration.observation_model: C_obs[i,k,t]=clip(C_true[i,k,t]+sigma*Z[i,k,t],0,1); Z~N(0,1). One Z field per evaluation seed is reused across D conditions, sigma levels and policies; observation stream is independent of potential Bernoulli reward stream.
configuration.demand: Unchanged C5 StationaryTaskDemand; all three task types present every period.
configuration.reward_generation: Bernoulli(mean=C_true[i,k,t]); existing pre-generated potential uniform per pair-period shared across organizations, sigma values and D conditions.
configuration.observation_noise_seed: evaluation_seed XOR 0x0B5E7A; random.Random.gauss(0,1), scaled by sigma. Separate from competence and reward seeds.
configuration.linucb: Existing PairwiseLinUCBAdapterNK with one current observed competence feature, alpha_from_delta(0.05), unchanged equations; feedback for selected assignments only.
configuration.p0: Existing P0ProductionOnlyNK over six one-to-one perfect matching candidates, scored from C_obs and public unit requirements only.
configuration.fixed_opt: Existing condition-specific fixed map trained on the 20 training seeds with known training reward means and held out from all evaluation seeds and observation noise.
configuration.oracle: Uses true C only for evaluator-side benchmark, regret and optimal assignment coincidence; never executable.
configuration.resources: Same existing one-to-one action/resource contract with maximum cardinality and collective budget 3 per period; actual assignments are recorded. Fixed and oracle policies use 900 assignments per episode; reactive/estimated policies may leave an edge unassigned when their observed-score rule ties at zero.

limitations: Gaussian observation errors are synthetic; clipping creates boundary mass and may induce nonzero bias near 0/1.
The fixed policy uses the preexisting training protocol with expected rewards from training trajectories; it does not experience evaluation observation noise.
The oracle sees true current competence and is evaluator-only, not a deployable policy.
The public expected-reward identity E[R]=C is correctly specified; this is observation noise, not structural model misspecification.
D1 and D2 jointly vary competence-shift amplitude and persistence; the interaction is descriptive, not a factorial identification of those two factors.
Twenty seeds per cell support bounded exploratory comparisons, not confirmatory generalization claims.
